{{Quote|The Republic base is still transmitting the all-clear signal. But for some reason our commando droids are still not responding.|The droid speaking to Grievous.|<ref name="Rookies">{{TCW|Rookies (episode)}}</ref>}}
A '''[[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]''' was stationed on the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] of [[Grievous/Legends|General Grievous's]] [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].

==History==
During the [[Defense of Rishi Station/Legends|Battle of the Rishi moon]], this [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] informed Grievous that the captured [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Listening post/Legends|base]] on the [[Rishi moon]] was still transmitting the all-clear signal, but the squadron of [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commandos]] who captured the base were not responding for some unknown reason. Grievous then ordered the droid to send reinforcements to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] to investigate the problem. Later, the droid informed Grievous that the Rishi moon base was destroyed, and was ordered by him to take the ship away before Republic reinforcements arrived.
